# BlueOrbit Devs
> Creative technology studio and software development brand building high-performance web applications, distributed real-time systems, zero-trust security infrastructure, and digital products.

## Core Products & Showcase
- [CoupleFlix](https://coupleflix.in): Synchronized watch-together platform featuring sub-50ms audio/video sync, WebRTC peer-to-peer data channels, and live spatial reaction rooms.
- [SecureAuth](https://secureauth.govt.hu): Zero-Trust authentication and identity vault featuring biometric WebAuthn Passkeys, encrypted TOTP provisioning, and anomaly risk engines.

## Services & Technical Capabilities
- [Product Strategy & Architecture](/services): System architecture blueprints, technical evaluation, MVP roadmapping, and data flow modeling.
- [UI/UX Engineering & Design Systems](/services): Bespoke design systems, micro-interactions, physics, and WCAG AA accessibility.
- [Modern Web Application Development](/services): Ultra-fast SPA & SSR web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- [Backend & High-Throughput APIs](/services): REST, GraphQL, and gRPC backends with strict validation, JWT/OAuth2/WebAuthn auth, and webhook pipelines.
- [Real-Time & Collaborative Systems](/services): Low-latency WebSockets, WebRTC audio/video mesh, multiplayer state sync, and CRDTs.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps](/services): Container orchestration (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, edge networks, and observability monitoring.
- [Workflow & Process Automation](/services): Distributed background job queues (BullMQ/Redis), webhook routers, and media transcoding pipelines.
- [AI & Intelligent Product Integrations](/services): LLM prompt pipelines, vector embeddings, RAG search, and agent tool calling.

## Engineering Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion / Framer Motion, Lucide Icons, Vite
- Backend & Runtimes: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, WebSockets (Socket.IO), WebRTC
- Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis (Pub/Sub & Caching), SQLite WASM
- Security & Auth: WebAuthn (Passkeys, Biometrics), Argon2id, AES-256-GCM, FIPS 140-3 standards
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Docker, Serverless Edge (Cloudflare Workers), CI/CD Pipelines
